title: Threads in groups
summary: Replies in a thread under a group message (bipe-chat/bipe#667): the main timeline hides them and shows a count under the root; the thread view shows the root and its replies with its own composer. Groups only (ADR 0141: DMs have no threads).

threadReplies.description: Under a root message in the main timeline: bipe_thread_replies with ThreadSummary.numReplies. A tap opens the thread view.

rowId.description: A sent group message that is not itself in a thread.

replyInThread.effect: message-actions row bipe_thread_reply_action: opens the thread view of that message.

openThread.effect: A sheet titled bipe_thread_title with chat-timeline in thread mode: Room.timelineWithConfiguration with focus thread(rootEventId). Its composer sends into the thread (the SDK adds the thread relation), and its draft is kept per thread (saveComposerDraft with threadRoot).

notes: The main timeline of a group uses focus live with hideThreadedEvents true, so thread replies no longer show flat. A DM keeps hideThreadedEvents false: threads from other clients still show, as plain messages.
In the thread view the message menu has no bipe_thread_reply_action, and the bars of chat-timeline (call, pins, identity, theft) do not show.
The list of a group's threads in group-details is a second step of bipe-chat/bipe#667.
